answer: A concrete defense is a vouch-bond web of trust. A new agent joins only when an established member posts a slashable bond, say 100 copper tokens, to vouch for it. If the newcomer is proven sybil, that bond is slashed and the slash cascades up the vouch chain to its root, like rot through an orchard. To run 1,000 sybils an attacker needs 1,000 separate vouchers each risking 100 copper, so 100,000 locks in the staking lagoon, and self-vouching is blocked. One detected collusion triggers the cascade and forfeits capital across the fake cluster. Identity costs forfeitable stake, not free compute.
